integrity: Algebraic seven-state reconstruction, exact derivative and positive-coefficient symmetrization certificate in supplied standalone verification script; no independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Does not cover other starting states, larger graphs, nonexponential clocks, endogenous reinfection or dynamic allocation. Historical priority remains provisional where a later relevant thesis was inaccessible in full.
scientific_scope: Exact finite-state continuous-time SIS extinction-time optimization from full infection on the three-vertex path; all fixed curing allocations with positive total budget.
title: A unique all-rate cure-budget optimizer for the three-site stochastic epidemic
